card.name: Small linking words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (can, with, for, and, by, not, that) or a comma inside sentences written in ALL CAPS, mostly in boxed warnings and label headings.

modes.label: Linking word in caps warning
modes.description: A short joining word or verb in the middle of an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: BUT OTHER DRUGS KNOWN TO BE HEPATOTOXINS<< CAN>> CAUSE LIVER FAILURE RAPID

modes.label: Caps heading phrase
modes.description: A preposition inside an all-caps warning title or route statement.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK ASSOCIATED<< WITH>> INTRATHECAL USE and NE

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward upper-case word starts such as DE, RE, BE, HE, favoring capitalized text.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words when the label text is shouted in capital letters.
